products.description: The Razer PBT Keycap Upgrade Set replaces stock keycaps with doubleshot PBT keycaps for mechanical keyboards. It is offered in Classic Black, Razer Green and Quartz Pink on the Razer US store.
products.keywords: razer pbt keycaps doubleshot upgrade set

specs.compatibility: Razer and standard-layout mechanical keyboards (US layout)
specs.colors: Classic Black, Quartz Pink, Razer Green

products.name: Razer PBT Keycap + Coiled Cable Upgrade Set
products.summary: Doubleshot PBT keycap set bundled with a matching coiled USB-C cable, in four colourways.
products.description: The Razer PBT Keycap + Coiled Cable Upgrade Set pairs doubleshot PBT keycaps with a matching coiled USB-C keyboard cable. It is offered in Classic Black, Mercury White, Quartz Pink and Razer Green on the Razer US store.
products.keywords: razer pbt keycaps coiled cable upgrade set

specs.compatibility: Razer and standard-layout mechanical keyboards with USB-C
specs.colors: Classic Black, Mercury White, Quartz Pink, Razer Green

products.name: NovelKeys NK Silk Awaken Switches
products.summary: NK Silk series linear switches pre-lubricated with Krytox 205g0, in Pink or Green.
products.description: The NK Silk series are among the smoothest stock linear switches, lubricated with Krytox 205g0. This is batch 2 with improved lubricant application, offered in Pink and Green.
products.keywords: novelkeys silk linear switches krytox lubed awaken

products.name: NovelKeys Classic Blue Switches
products.summary: NovelKeys x TypePlus Classic Blue switches, offered lubricated or unlubricated.
products.description: NovelKeys Classic Blue switches are produced with TypePlus and sold on the NovelKeys store in lubricated and unlubricated versions at the same price.
products.keywords: novelkeys classic blue switches typeplus
